manual_review_reason: 4ZZZ uses an official JavaScript-dependent form that requests artist and release metadata, identity and optional demographic information, biography or press-pack context, content warnings, social links, cover art and a downloadable WAV or 320-kbps MP3 link. Spotify links are not accepted, while Bandcamp or Apple Music submissions require a download code. The form also asks for permission to play the release before its release date and requires acknowledgement that 4ZZZ may broadcast it. A human must inspect the live controls, approve all permissions and identity disclosures, verify link access and rights and submit manually.

2SER's official page provides a public form for airplay consideration and requests first and last name, email, location, release date, artist or band name, release title, artist biography and social-media links. The form is dynamically loaded, and the static page does not expose all live validation, music-link requirements, declarations or possible anti-spam controls. A human must inspect the current form, confirm international eligibility and required track-delivery fields, approve all submitted data and complete the workflow manually.

platform: Triple R 102.7FM Official Station Email and Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: Triple R publicly authorizes station-wide servicing through music@rrr.org.au. A compliant email needs a clear subject, a no-login streaming link, a non-expiring high-quality 320-kbps MP3 or WAV download link, clearly named files, a short biography and relevant gig details; large audio attachments are prohibited. Artists may alternatively service suitable public program contacts or mail physical CDs, LPs or cassettes to the Music Department. A human must choose the correct route, prepare compliant links and metadata, verify rights and expiry settings and address any physical package exactly.

platform: SYN Media Official Music Directors Email Submission Route
manual_review_reason: SYN Media publicly directs music servicing to music@syn.org.au. The email must include a downloadable 320-kbps MP3 or WAV link rather than direct attachments, a press release or artist biography, track or release title, release date and relevant website, social, gig and previous-release links. Music Directors review submissions on a rolling basis and may not reply. A human must prepare the release package, ensure download permissions and metadata are correct, keep music and interview requests separated and send the email manually.

platform: 95bFM Official Lossless Music Submission Email Route
manual_review_reason: 95bFM's official guidance directs artists to a protected email contact and requires both an immediately accessible streaming link and a download link to a lossless master such as WAV or FLAC. Links must not require the station to create an account or enter a password; Spotify is unsuitable. The message should include artist and song names, release date, origin and only brief context. Tracks older than one month are no longer eligible for high-rotation A/B playlisting. A human must confirm the protected address in the browser, prepare compliant no-login links, verify release timing and rights and send manually.
